description: Conditionally passes or blocks a pulse signal based on the state of an enable input. When a rising edge arrives on the input and enable is true, the pulse is forwarded to the output. When enable is false, the pulse is suppressed.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: Pulse signal. A rising edge triggers evaluation of the enable state to decide whether to forward the pulse.

inputs.name: Enable
inputs.description: Level input checked at the moment a pulse arrives. When true, pulses pass through. When false, pulses are blocked. Changing this input does not trigger output on its own.

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: Forwarded pulse. Mirrors the input pulse when the gate is enabled.

state.name: Previous input state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the input to detect rising and falling edges.
